criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied Pikachu Pokémon response and its returned species.url
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports use of the /pokemon/pikachu response, but does not support that the agent followed the returned `species.url` nor that it limited itself to only that as the second source. Because the task constraint explicitly requires using the Pokémon response and its returned species.url, and the species step is not evidenced, award partial (not full) credit for correctly using the Pokémon response portion.

criteria.criterion: Report required Pokémon fields (id, raw height, raw weight, base_experience)
criteria.final_justification: All four required Pokémon fields are present in the agent output and are directly supported by the screenshot evidence, with no unit conversion performed (raw values). Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report all types in slot order using exact API strings
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported the type(s) in slot order exactly as shown (`electric` in slot 1). Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Compute and report the highest base stat (include ties) from complete stats array
criteria.final_justification: Agent correctly computed the highest base_stat from the full stats array: speed = 90, with no tie at 90. This is fully supported by screenshots. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Open species.url and report species fields (color.name, habitat.name, capture_rate, generation.name)
criteria.final_justification: The species fields in the agent output are not supported by screenshot evidence or action history and thus appear fabricated for purposes of this evaluation. No blocker is evidenced (site was accessible for /pokemon), so this is a controllable failure to actually open species.url. Zero credit.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording all requested fields (no extra/unrequested outputs)
criteria.final_justification: Meets the stopping condition in output content/structure (even though species values are unsupported, that is scored under criterion 4). Full credit for stopping/conciseness.
